'''Mitchell Alan Berman''' (born February 7, 1986) is an American politician and [[registered nurse]] from [[Racine County, Wisconsin]]. A member of the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]], he is the member-elect to the [[United States House of Representatives]] for {{ushr|WI|1}}.

== Early life and career ==
Mitchell was born and raised in [[Peshtigo, Wisconsin]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Casey |first=Evan |date=2026-10-22 |title=Republicans have held Wisconsin's 1st Congressional District for decades. Could this be the year it flips? |url=https://www.wpr.org/news/1st-house-district-bryan-steil-mitchell-berman-2026 |access-date=2026-11-04 |website=WPR |language=en-US}}</ref> He earned a Bachelor of Science degree in nursing from [[Marian University (Wisconsin)|Marian University]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-09-30 |title=Wisconsin's 1st Congressional District 2026: Steil vs. Berman {{!}} Racine County Eye |url=https://racinecountyeye.com/racine-county-voter-guide-2026/us-house-wisconsin-1st-district-2026/ |access-date=2026-11-04 |language=en-US}}</ref> Berman worked with Teamsters Local 344 while in college. He also served for 10 years as a nurse in a [[United States Department of Veterans Affairs]] clinic in Wisconsin and has been employed by [[National Nurses United]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-10-20 |title=Berman campaign: Mitchell Berman named “Unrig Washington” candidate by End Citizens United, calls on Steil to support real stock trading ban |url=https://www.wispolitics.com/2026/berman-campaign-mitchell-berman-named-unrig-washington-candidate-by-end-citizens-united-calls-on-steil-to-support-real-stock-trading-ban/ |access-date=2026-11-04 |website=WisPolitics |language=en-US}}</ref>

== U.S. House of Representatives==
In August 2025, Berman announced his candidacy for the [[United States House of Representatives]] in {{ushr|WI|1}} in the 2026 elections as a member of the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=August 12, 2025 |title=Berman campaign: Democrat launches campaign for Wisconsin's First Congressional District |url=https://www.wispolitics.com/2025/berman-campaign-democrat-launches-campaign-for-wisconsins-first-congressional-district/ |access-date=August 12, 2025 |website=[[WisPolitics]]}}</ref> Endorsed by the [[Blue Dog Coalition|Blue Dog PAC]]<ref>https://bluedogdems.com/mitchell-berman/</ref>, he defeated incumbent [[Bryan Steil]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Yurk |first=Ricardo Torres and Valerie |title=Mitchell Berman defeats Bryan Steil in Wisconsin's 1st District |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/11/03/mitchell-berman-defeats-bryan-steil-in-wisconsins-1st-district/92415764007/ |access-date=2026-11-04 |website=Journal Sentinel |language=en-US}}</ref>
